The interactions involved increased activation across task conditions among HC participants and an opposite pattern of decreasing activation among IGD participants in the two largest cortical and subcortical clusters; HC participants also showed increasing activity in IFG, MFG and SFG, while IGD participants exhibited relatively unchanged activity. These findings indicate relatively blunted neural responses to negative affective stimuli among individuals with IGD.
